_about: Curated HSN keywords that legitimately name more than one heading. scripts/check-hsn-keywords.mjs fails on any duplicate that is not listed here, and on a listed keyword whose code set changed. Every entry needs a reason.
_rules: parent-child: a chapter (61, 62) and its heading share the word; the heading ranks first.
two-products: the word really names two different goods; the first code is the usual reading.
bare-or-insulated: a wire or cable is classified by whether it is insulated.
three-oils: cooking oil covers the whole 1507-1515 range; each code is a different oil.

acid.why: two-products: 2801 is fluorine/bromine/iodine acids, 2806 is hydrochloric and other chlorine acids

bottle.why: two-products: plastic bottle (3923) and glass bottle (7013)

cabinet.why: two-products: computer cabinet (8473) and furniture cabinet (9403); the shorter 8473 description wins the tie, see docs/hsn-audit.md P1

cooking oil.why: three-oils: soya-bean (1507), groundnut (1508), palm (1511); the vendor picks from the list

copper.why: two-products: refined copper (7403) and copper wire (7408)

copper wire.why: bare-or-insulated: 7408 is bare copper wire, 8544 is insulated wire and cable

cream.why: two-products: milk cream (0401) and cosmetic cream (3304)

fibre board.why: two-products: wood fibre board or MDF (4411) and boards of vegetable fibre or cement (6808)

formal wear.why: parent-child: chapter 62 and the men's suit heading 6203

innerwear.why: parent-child: chapter 61 and the T-shirt and vest heading 6109

lamp.why: two-products: a lamp bulb (8539) and a lamp fitting or luminaire (9405)

led light.why: two-products: an LED bulb (8539) and an LED luminaire (9405); 9405 ranks first

motor.why: two-products: a spark-ignition engine (8407) and an electric motor (8501)

napkin.why: two-products: paper napkin (4818) and cloth table or toilet linen (6302)

particle board.why: two-products: wood particle board (4410) and cement or mineral bonded board (6808)

plate.why: two-products: a ceramic plate (6911) and a steel plate or sheet (7208)

shirt.why: parent-child: chapter 62 and the men's shirt heading 6205

spice.why: two-products: pepper (0904) and mixed or other spices (0910)

steel sheet.why: two-products: plain hot-rolled sheet (7208) and coated or galvanised sheet (7210)

suit.why: parent-child: chapter 62 and the men's suit heading 6203

t-shirt.why: parent-child: chapter 61 and the T-shirt heading 6109

tablet.why: two-products: a medicine tablet (3004) and a tablet computer (8471)

trouser.why: parent-child: chapter 62 and the trousers heading 6203

tshirt.why: parent-child: an unspaced spelling of the 6109 pair above

tube light.why: two-products: the tube lamp (8539) and the fitted luminaire (9405); 9405 ranks first

washer.why: two-products: a steel washer (7318) and a washing machine (8450)
